summary.text: Shawn Keenan, a Democratic mortgage broker and loan officer from Coeur d'Alene, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Idaho Secretary of State to Phil McGrane.
It was a rematch with Republican incumbent McGrane, and Keenan had also run for the office in 2022 and lost the general election.

paragraphs.text: Keenan lives in Coeur d'Alene, and his parents moved with him to Idaho when he was 1 year old.
He works as a mortgage broker and loan officer, runs a nonprofit called the North Idaho Kindness Project and has worked on several Democratic campaigns in North Idaho.
Keenan was the Democratic nominee for secretary of state in 2022 and lost to McGrane in the November general election.
He advanced from the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary.
He received 32.6% of the vote to Phil McGrane's 67.4%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
